name: blender viewport navigation with middle mouse
goal: Orbit, pan, zoom, and snap orthographic views in Blender's 3D viewport.

source.title: ABSOLUTE Beginner Basics.. Blender For Noobs 2025

prerequisites: Mouse with middle button / scroll wheel preferred

inputs.name: scene
inputs.description: Open Blender scene with at least one object

outputs.name: viewport_view
outputs.description: Operator can orbit/pan/zoom and snap to ortho views

constraints: Middle mouse button (MMB) scroll zooms; MMB drag orbits
Numpad 1/3/7/9 for front/right/top/bottom ortho; without numpad use Alt+MMB drag to snap views

steps.action: Scroll the middle mouse wheel to zoom in and out.
Click and drag the middle mouse button to orbit around the object.
Hold Shift and middle-mouse-drag to pan the scene.
If you have a numpad: 1 front orthographic, 3 right, 7 top, 9 bottom.
Without a numpad: hold Alt, middle-mouse-drag toward the desired axis to snap orthographic views.

verification: Can orbit, pan, and zoom without using toolbar gizmo icons
